title: Inconsistent, and not a tight seal for two, or one chicken breast in a bag.
text:
Inconsistent, and not a tight seal for two, or one chicken breast in a bag.. I have had another type of vacuum sealer and loved it, but gave it to one of my kids ! ( what was I thinking!! ).
So I had high hopes for this smaller, good looking food sealer.. I even went and bought 20 Chicken breasts to use this sealer for.
My daughter and I started sealing chicken breasts using this.
A big disappointment. This food sealer vacuum did not seal strong enough to give a tight seal for two chicken breast in one bag,
Then I put one chicken breast in one bag, still did not seal good.
I did press the button for a moist seal.
The more I used this the less consistent it was. Sometimes half the bag got sealed better then the other half, or the seal was not tight enough, or it just would Not seal!
Needless to say, I got out my trusty zip lock one quart baggies and got a tighter seal.

Btw, the heat seal worked good, but the suction just didn’t seal tight. So if you just want to seal important papers,
Nuts etc. this sealer might do the job.
For me its a One star...Sorry to say.
